blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Peppermint Bizmoto Inc. (PBI), a financial technology provider holding an electronic money issuer (EMI) license under the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), has signed a strategic digital payment services agreement with FlashPay, the financial technology arm of the logistical conglomerate Flash Group. The arrangement integrates Peppermint’s National QR Code Standard (QR Ph) compliant person-to-merchant (P2M) settlement framework into FlashPay’s merchant payment collection platform. The infrastructure is designed to facilitate secure, interoperable digital transaction flows across participating businesses within the Flash Group, establishing an alternative to traditional cash-heavy operations.
